# Westerville WTP expansion: visitor rules (Bramhall Construction)

- Every visitor watches the 15-minute site orientation video before arriving (bramhallbuilds.com/orient, code
  WWTP26) and brings photo ID.
- Required PPE: hard hat, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, steel- or composite-toe boots, long pants. We lend
  hard hats, glasses and vests; we do not lend boots.
- Escorted groups are limited to 8 visitors per escort. One escort is available on 11/5.
- Visitor names are due to the site office 24 hours before the visit.
- Tours may be rescheduled on the day for crane lifts or weather.
